theme: Blue hour on an elevated train platform: the train pulls away and leaves the platform still; the line sits in the sky from the first frame

philosophy.idea: Busyness steals the time we think we lack: the most occupied people are the least able to live, so stop and choose
philosophy.source: Seneca, On the Shortness of Life, ch. 7 (the preoccupied, occupati, are the last to learn how to live)
philosophy.use: interpretation in our own words, not a quote

hooks_considered: everyone's. rushing. you. can. stand. still. and. choose.
everyone. is. rushing. somewhere. you're. allowed. to. stand. still. and. choose.
busy. isn't. the. same. as. alive. choose. your. hour.
hook_note: Shortened from the idea's 11 words to 8 after the 2026-11-25 early read (v007 viewers left at about 1.8 s); readable in about 2 s.

post.caption: Feeling behind in life when everyone seems to be running somewhere. Seneca noticed the busiest people often had the least time to actually live. If you stood still for a minute, what would you choose? 🚉
post.pinned_comment: What's one thing you'd do today if nobody was rushing you? 👇
